plan.title: Crossing the Bitterroots — September 1805
plan.rationale: The 'bitterroot-september-1805' scope directly matches the filmmaker's brief for research on the Bitterroot crossing in September 1805, covering the period from September 9th to September 30th, 1805. This ensures all retrieved evidence will be highly relevant to the specified time and location of the expedition's arduous journey.

requirements.title: Mountainous Terrain and Trail Conditions
requirements.production_need: To accurately depict the physical challenges, visual landscape, and specific obstacles encountered by the expedition in the Bitterroot Mountains for set design and cinematography.
requirements.success_criteria: Passages describing the physical characteristics of the mountains, the condition of the trail, and the difficulty of travel, including specific geographical features.

requirements.title: Weather Conditions During the Bitterroot Crossing
requirements.production_need: To inform visual effects, costume design, and the overall atmosphere of the journey, emphasizing the harsh environmental conditions faced by the party.
requirements.success_criteria: Descriptions of daily weather, temperature, precipitation, and any significant weather events that impacted the expedition.

requirements.title: Food Scarcity and Hunting Efforts
requirements.production_need: To illustrate the expedition's struggle for sustenance, the methods used to acquire food, and the impact of scarcity on morale and physical state.
requirements.success_criteria: Accounts of food supply, hunting success or failure, descriptions of hunger or meals, and any interactions related to acquiring food.

requirements.title: Health and Exhaustion of the Expedition Members
requirements.production_need: To portray the physical toll, suffering, and medical challenges endured by the party, informing character performance and makeup effects.
requirements.success_criteria: Passages detailing the physical ailments, injuries, general state of health, and any medical treatments or observations of the men.

requirements.title: Challenges with Horses and Pack Animals
requirements.production_need: To accurately depict the critical role of horses in the crossing, the difficulties encountered with them, and their condition, for animal wrangling and logistical planning.
requirements.success_criteria: Descriptions of the horses' condition, their use as pack animals, any incidents or difficulties related to them, and their impact on the expedition's progress.
